events.speaker: PRISCA
events.text: Cobbett's paper already has three versions of what happened out there, none of them true. I'd like the actual one, if you'll give it to me.

events.speaker: PRISCA
events.text: There. Boring, accurate, and going to press before Cobbett's version gets any less wrong.

events.speaker: PRISCA
events.text: A place, and an honest source when this outfit's story is worth printing. I'll take that.

events.speaker: PRISCA
events.text: You checked your facts before you told them to me. Do you know how rare that is in my line of work?
